note: Hand-authored inputs for tools/map-processor/build_map.py and the measurements made on the scene.
traversalsNote: Game uu. Ropes, ziplines, teleporters and jumps measured on the scene: a and b are the walk-grid cells at the two ends (they become roadmap nodes joined by a link in <map>.nav.json), zones the zone at each end. See tools/map-mesh/README.md.

traversals.name: A Short teleporter -> B Short
traversals.note: A Short teleporter exits at B Short (B Exit room)
traversals.basis: Game metres. Entry = frame KingdomTech_1_TeleporterFrame.002 (x 91.58..97.46, y 4.16..5.05, z 2.00..5.75): a = the walk cell under the middle of the frame. Arrival = the closed room with floor TeleporterReceiver_4_FloorGrating (x 84.13..93.84, y -24.21..-15.89, z 5.04), left through the door frame KingdomTech_1_TeleporterFrame.003: b = the cell at the middle of that floor. soundSource = middle of the entry frame.
traversals.provenance: measured-on-mesh (entry frame, arrival room, the two cells); manual-approx (1.5 s travel time is an estimate; which entry leads to which room: game knowledge)

traversals.name: B Long teleporter -> A Lobby

traversals.provenance: measured-on-mesh (entry frame, arrival room, the two cells); manual-approx (1.5 s travel time is an estimate; which entry leads to which room: game knowledge)

objectsNote: Game uu. Doors and breakables located on the scene: position is on the floor in the opening, normal the horizontal direction through it. Read by tools/map-mesh/pipeline/objects_map.py.

objects.name: B Short teleporter exit door
objects.basis: Game metres. Frame KingdomTech_1_TeleporterFrame.003 (x 86.08..91.95, y -25.04..-24.14, z 5.00..8.75) in the south wall of the arrival room; the walk grid passes it at x 87.1..91.1 (8 cells). Position = the cell in the middle of the passage. The door leaves are not separate objects in the scene.
objects.provenance: measured-on-mesh (frame object, passage, floor height); manual-approx (that the frame holds the arrival room's exit door and that it is closed until someone arrives: game knowledge)

mechanics.name: Two one-way teleporters (A Short -> B Short, B Long -> A Lobby)
mechanics.how: two one-way roadmap links between measured points (traversals in this file), each with its own travel time; the zone graph carries one edge kind=teleporter per link, no sound link (the map-wide teleporter audio cue is NOT modelled; the exit doors are listed in bind.objects.json but not simulated)
mechanics.provenance: measured-on-mesh (entry frames, arrival rooms); manual-approx (which entry leads where, travel time: general game knowledge)
